title: A derived Zinbiel algebra without a differential Zinbiel embedding in characteristic different from two and three
source_version: Official SIGMA 20 (2024) journal PDF and native TeX; acquired 2026-09-30; exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The counterexample requires choosing a derivative-stable envelope ideal and a distinguished nonzero element in its contraction, then exhausting the derived ideal using explicit free-algebra normal forms and a rank obstruction. The displayed coefficient matrix supplies the finite verification.
author: Pavel Kolesnikov; Farukh Mashurov; Bauyrzhan Sartayev
